geography_notes: Northern region (wiki): Al Kharid, Het's Oasis, Mage Training Arena; ends at Shantay Pass; no desert heat north of the pass.
Middle region: Kalphite Lair, Desert Mining Camp, Bedabin Camp, Uzer, Dominion Tower, Bandit Camp, Pollnivneach; desert heat applies outside safe settlements.
Southern region: Nardah, Menaphos, Sophanem, pyramids, Ullek ruins.
Het's Oasis is northern (NE of Al Kharid), not mid-south or near Menaphos.
Garden of Kharid is on the northern border of the Kharidian Desert.
Kharid-et Dig Site is east of present-day Al Kharid (northern band).

findings.title: data/league/regions.json areas lag catalog / placeAnchors
findings.detail: Ship file regions.json lists only official Jagex examples (Menaphos, Het's Oasis). Research catalog and map anchors also list Kharid-et Dig Site, Sophanem, and Garden of Kharid. Product map anchors require catalog area names; Research UI areas come from catalog; runtime league regions use the thinner list. Not a wiki falsehood, but a real three-way product inconsistency.
findings.wiki_support: All five catalog areas are genuine Kharidian Desert locations. Sophanem/Menaphos twin cities; Kharid-et and Garden of Kharid are northern desert landmarks.

proposed_fix.action: Expand desert.areas to match catalog (recommended order north→south): Garden of Kharid, Kharid-et Dig Site, Het's Oasis, Sophanem, Menaphos — or at minimum keep official examples first and append catalog extras.

findings.title: Het's Oasis placeAnchor UV and comment place it mid-south; wiki places it northern
findings.detail: placeAnchors comment says 'oasis mid-south' and UV y=0.845 sits between Kharid-et (0.75) and Sophanem (0.9). Wiki: Het's Oasis is north-east of Al Kharid (former Duel Arena), same northern band as Garden of Kharid and Kharid-et. On this map frame higher UV.y is south (cf. Varrock 0.42 vs Lumbridge 0.59). Het's Oasis should cluster with Garden/Kharid-et (~0.72–0.78), not approach Menaphite latitudes.
evidence: https://runescape.wiki/w/Het%27s_Oasis — northern Kharidian Desert, NE of Al Kharid
https://runescape.wiki/w/Kharidian_Desert#Northern_region — Het's Oasis listed in northern region

proposed_fix.action: Move Het's Oasis UV north into the Al Kharid / Garden / Kharid-et cluster (suggested starting point [0.53, 0.76] or similar after ring-containment test); fix comment to 'northern oasis (former Duel Arena)'. Re-run placeAnchors tests.

findings.title: Al Kharid absent from areas despite full-desert League coverage and wiki Desert badge
findings.detail: Wiki Al Kharid page carries Desert League Region Badge. Equilibrium League/Areas/Desert states the area covers the entire Kharidian Desert. Official Jagex example list only named Menaphos and Het's Oasis — intentional marketing subset, not a claim that Al Kharid is excluded. Local quest mapping already treats Al Kharid starts as desert (data/league/quests.json). Missing Al Kharid from areas under-represents the northern hub players actually use.
evidence: data/league/quests.json primary_region desert for Al Kharid start_area quests
findings.not_an_error_because: Official published examples only listed Menaphos + Het's Oasis; planner may keep a short highlight list. Still the strongest missing settlement for full-desert fidelity.

proposed_fix.target: data/league/regions.json (and later catalog via normal research pipeline — do not hand-edit catalog here)
proposed_fix.action: Add 'Al Kharid' to areas (after sync policy is chosen). Optional placeAnchor near [0.51, 0.74] once present in catalog areas.
proposed_fix.optional_hardRule: Treat Al Kharid and the northern free desert as Desert, not Misthalin. Wiki League badge and full-desert boundary support this.

findings.title: Major middle/southern settlements not in areas list (Pollnivneach, Nardah, etc.)
findings.detail: Wiki major cities also include Pollnivneach and Nardah; camps and ruins (Bandit Camp, Bedabin Camp, Uzer, Desert Mining Camp) are widely known landmarks. Catalog deliberately highlights Menaphos/Het's Oasis + Archaeology/Farming northern sites + Sophanem. That is a valid League UI subset as long as content/upgrades still capture combat and slayer geography.

proposed_fix.action: No required add for every landmark. Prefer content/upgrade rows for combat hubs; only promote to areas if the map/region detail UX needs another pin. Highest-value optional area promotions: Al Kharid (DES-03), Pollnivneach (Sumona / Smoking Kills / POH), Nardah (Desert amulet / Heart of Gielinor approach).

findings.title: Catalog combat content maps correctly to desert geography
findings.detail: Kalphite Queen/King, Sophanem Slayer Dungeon / The Magister, Heart of Gielinor / Telos, and Amascut (Menaphos) all sit in the Kharidian Desert on live wiki. Heart of Gielinor and Dominion Tower carry Desert League badges. Confidence labels (inferred_region / historical_catalyst_*) are honest pending finer Equilibrium locality tables.

findings.title: Empty aliases / hardRules / warnings under-document full-desert League boundary
findings.detail: Display name is correctly 'Desert' (Equilibrium product term). Wiki formal name is Kharidian Desert. quest-region-rules already knows al kharid / pollnivneach / nardah / dominion tower terms, but regions record carries no hardRule for planners.

hardRules: Desert covers the full Kharidian Desert geography (including Al Kharid, northern free desert, members desert south of Shantay Pass, and underground/instance content entered from desert). Do not reassign Al Kharid to Misthalin without an Equilibrium override.
Official published highlight examples are Menaphos and Het's Oasis; they do not exhaust the region.
warnings: Equilibrium League/Areas/Desert wiki page still has sparse unlock/settlement tables — use location wiki pages + full-desert boundary until Jagex publishes finer locality lists.
Red sandstone also exists at Oo'glog (not Desert-only); Sophanem is the Desert source in the red-sandstone upgrade row.

findings.title: Name 'Desert' vs wiki 'Kharidian Desert' is intentional product naming
findings.detail: Jagex Equilibrium materials and wiki League nav use Desert / Kharidian Desert interchangeably for the region. No rename required. Aliases (DES-07) cover search.

findings.title: Dominion Tower and Pyramid Plunder already tracked as upgrades, not areas — acceptable
findings.detail: Dominion Tower is correctly desert combat (wiki Desert badge) and appears in upgrades as a non-skilling pointer. Pyramid Plunder / black ibis is desert Thieving. No error; optional future area pins only if map density needs them.
